text: The robot handled 11 out of 36 orders successfully within an average time of 126 seconds per order, though some deliveries took up to 817 seconds as seen in order #2 for a water bottle. The top failure reason was "unknown" issues, which occurred 16 times across multiple orders [cite:7]. Orders that were slow or had warnings often involved items like towels and socks. To improve efficiency, focus on troubleshooting common unknown failures to speed up delivery times.
